GUEST INFORMATION AND ONLINE CHECK-IN

In order to provide for a quicker, smoother experience at the cruise terminal, please complete all of the steps below.

Click on each guest name below to complete the Guest Information and Travel Acknowledgment/Ticket Contract steps, which must be done prior to your Cruise Vacation Documents being mailed. The remainder of the steps will be available beginning 21 days prior to embarkation and must be completed at least four (4) days prior to embarkation.

Once all steps are complete, you will receive a Boarding Pass which must be presented at the embarkation terminal, along with your passport, required visas or other travel documents, and any necessary health-related documentation (e.g., proof of a required vaccination for a specific destination). If you require assistance with the check-in process, please contact Reservations.
